preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: Each non-empty line in stdin contains exactly one string (no extra spaces or tokens).

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and 1 <= len(s) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of lowercase English letters and has length n where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(p) <= len(s) for p in stdout.split()) and len(stdout.split()) == len(s))
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, stdout is '-1'. Otherwise, stdout contains exactly n space-separated integers P₁, P₂, ..., Pₙ where each Pᵢ is in [1, n].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(s[int(p)-1] == s[int(q)-1] for i, (p, q) in enumerate(zip(stdout.split(), reversed(stdout.split()))) if i != len(s)//2)
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', the permutation P applied to s produces a palindromic string t, meaning t[i] == t[n-i+1] for all 1 ≤ i < n (1-based indexing).
